name: Discovery and unlock overlay
purpose: Celebrate already-granted deterministic discoveries without blocking the current activity.
on_enter: Open only from durable pendingCelebrations queue at a safe interaction boundary. Rewards were already committed by the triggering service.
Capture returnContext with scene, draft/context IDs and substate, not live DOM objects.
Show exactly one discovery at a time in stable rule order.
on_exit: Mark shown celebration acknowledged; next queued item or restore underlying context.
persistence: acknowledgedCelebrations changes; unlock/coin ledgers are read-only here. Closing does not grant, revoke or reroll rewards.
back_rule: Continue and Back both acknowledge one card. After final card resume captured route. Home goes02 after durable acknowledgement.
acceptance: Reload after grant but before display still owns reward and shows queued celebration once.
Skipping all visual motion grants nothing extra.
Queue never interrupts a contact, pour, save transaction or adult import.
implementation_notes: Background scrim is a modal overlay over the actual underlying scene, not a fresh play scene.
Progress indicator is pictorial requirement state, not a timed meter.

actions.trigger: Tap Continue, Back or keyboard activate
actions.guard: Current celebration ID exists and not in acknowledgement transaction
actions.command: Acknowledge current queue item; show next or restore returnContext
actions.feedback: Short item reveal may be skipped.
actions.interrupt: Repeat while pending ignored; no wallet mutation.
